newsitem.title: UK: Copper reaches $2,100 on LME -new 2-1/2 month high.
newsitem.headline: Copper reaches $2,100 on LME -new 2-1/2 month high.

text.p: Copper prices hit the $2,100 a tonne level during late Friday morning London Metal Exchange (LME) trading, the highest for 2-1/2 months.
Traders said the price advance from overnight levels of $2,032 reflected speculative buying and shortcovering, with LME inventories having dropped to 6-1/4 year lows.
